answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the juniper of a task receipt, and the lantern is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the vault of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
